fact: The Portfolio Committee on Social Development says SASSA administers the SRD application and payment system, which uses a mobile money service to pay grants.

The Minister of Social Development says SRD grant payments run through beneficiary bank accounts, with accounts lacking biometric FICA verification placed in a 'referred' status that blocks further payments.
system: SASSA Social Relief of Distress grant

fact: SASSA's 2026 grant booklet says it requires applicants to give an active personal bank account in their own name, supporting Electronic Fund Transfers, for payment of social assistance benefits.
